Name: Soft's Void Chicken Recolor for 1.6 (CP and AT)
Author: SeaSea50
Description:
[center][/center][center][img]https://i.ibb.co/ZxMrNps/mod-details-1.png[/img]

Updates [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10116]Soft's Void Chicken Recolor[/url]﻿ to work with 1.6! With two versions to choose from: Content Patcher or Alternative Textures

Let me know if there's any bugs, or if you'd like me to add anything.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/JtMTbjw/installation.png<img src=[/img]

This is a Content Patcher OR Alternative Textures mod, so it goes in your mods folder in order to work. Here's a step by step process:
 [list=1]
[*]Download and unzip this mod 
[*]Drag and drop into your mods folder
[*]You're all done!


[img]https://i.ibb.co/y0bTYfR/credits.png[/img]
[/list]
Thank you so so much Soft ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/98259968]softfragile[/url]) for giving me permission to update my favourite void chicken retexture in order to make it work with 1.6. Checkout the original mod page: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10116]Soft's Void Chicken Recolor[/url]﻿ :D

Can't forget to thank ConcernedApe for making Stardew Valley[/center]
